acceptanceCriteria: The failing companion and the expected/actual help output are recorded from the hosted log.
The smoke expectation or the companion help output is corrected per its owning spec, with a test.
A hosted macos-15 run passes companion-release-gate, with the run id retained.
body: Observed in release-gates nightly run 38052349384 (main 1b35c6a8, 2026-10-10, macos-15). The companion-release-gate installed-binary smoke test reports 'unexpected help admission' for a corvint-js-test companion. Exact failing companion and expected vs actual help output to be captured from the run log. Blocks a green nightly full gate for 1.0.0-rc.3 (decision 0491 cut).
title: companion-release-gate fails on the nightly macos-15 leg: installed smoke reports unexpected help admission
